tools.name: agentdna_about
tools.description: Explains AgentDNA (company catalogs for AI agents), its price (30 days free, then 4.90 USD/month) and the exact steps for a company to publish its products for agents. No input.

tools.name: agentdna_list_companies
tools.description: Lists the companies that publish a live AgentDNA catalog, with verified status, product count and catalog URL.

tools.name: agentdna_get_catalog
tools.description: Returns a company's full AgentDNA catalog (products, prices, availability, contact) by its domain.

tools.name: agentdna_search_products
tools.description: Searches product names and descriptions across every live AgentDNA catalog and returns matches with company, price and availability.

tools.name: agentdna_start_trial
tools.description: Creates an AgentDNA catalog for a company and returns its private API key (shown once) and the next steps. Free for 30 days, no card. Use only for a company you act for; the catalog is not verified until the domain owner proves the domain.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentdna_list_companies · Private data: agentdna_get_catalog, agentdna_start_trial · Public sink: agentdna_about, agentdna_list_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentdna_list_companies · Private data: agentdna_get_catalog, agentdna_start_trial · Public sink: agentdna_about, agentdna_list_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
